title: Texas Roadhouse Gift Cards
description: A contest entry for Texas Roadhouse and their gift cards (that should have won!!)

asr.full_text: Hello? Hey happy birthday man did you get my present yet? Ugh. Did you send me a steak in the mail? Dude it's not just ANY steak. It's delicious hand-cut steak from Texas Roadhouse. You can't send me a restaurant in the mail. Did you even check the other packages? It just doesn't work that way all right? You can't... OOOOOOOOHHHHHHHHH Jake? There's a better way. Just pick up a gift card from a Texas Roadhouse or customize it on their website.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a humorous birthday-style exchange about an impossible mailed steak before redirecting the recipient to an ordinary Texas Roadhouse gift card or customization option. The title, description, closing brand logo, and gift-card website frame it as promotional or entertainment content. It does not describe deceptive claims, unusual payment demands, credential collection, victim loss, or problematic website behavior.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video promotes an ordinary commercial product: a Texas Roadhouse gift card, with a recommendation to pick one up or customize it. The gift card images and closing brand/website display support the commercial context.
